references.text: Israel departed from the Red Sea (Yam Suf) and entered the Wilderness of Shur, which parallels the journey described in Numbers 33:11.
The Israelites came to the Wilderness of Sin, located between Elim and Sinai. This confirms the campsite mentioned in Numbers 33:11.
But the congregation departed from the Wilderness of Sin and continued their journey onward, showing the same route as described in Numbers 33.
